_comment: Master relay template — environment-tested baseline. Copy → rename → fill in task fields. Update as new patterns emerge in learnings/.
_learnings: Accumulated from STEP-01/02/03 on Plausit (2026-08-05): workdir not applied by delegate_task, Docker unavailable in container, CSS grep whitespace sensitivity, self-verification catches real bugs.
task_description: REPLACE ME — Self-contained. No project shorthand, no 'as discussed'.
testing_methodology:
# Verbatim shell commands. Must include >=1 negative test + >=1 structural shape assertion.
# Docker is UNAVAILABLE in subagent environment (no daemon, no socket, no sudo).
# Use python3 -m http.server for web validation, python3 -c for structural checks.
# CSS grep tip: use regex like 'prop.*value' not 'prop:value' — CSS whitespace varies.
# Background server pattern:
#   python3 -m http.server PORT --bind 127.0.0.1  (use background=true)
#   curl -sS http://localhost:PORT/path
#   kill $(lsof -t -i:PORT) 2>/dev/null || pkill -f 'http.server PORT'
surprises_checklist: Did every command succeed on first attempt?
Did you read anything outside this relay file?
Did any test need adjustment beyond what the relay specified?
Did you modify any file NOT in target_files?
Did you add any dependency not in constraints?
stop_conditions: ⚠️ STOP: If Docker commands fail, do NOT attempt to install or start Docker. Use python3 -m http.server instead.
⚠️ STOP: If pip/apt-get/apt fail, do NOT attempt alternative package managers. Work with what's installed.
⚠️ STOP: If git commit fails with 'Author identity unknown', run: git config user.email 'architect@project' && git config user.name 'Master Architect'. ONE attempt only.
